description: FirmwareProfile is the firmware that a group of machines should run. You keep it in git, and it applies to the Hosts that match its selector. As a BiosProfile, it states intent, and no controller reconciles it directly. For a machine that drifts from it, the operator proposes a HostOperation. A flash can stop the machine, so the operation waits for approval.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: FirmwareProfileSpec is one layer of desired firmware for the Hosts it matches. As a BiosProfile, it is data without a controller. The convergence reconciler compares the desired version with the version that the endpoints report, and proposes a flash operation on drift. Firmware converges before BIOS, because the BIOS schema depends on the firmware.

fields.name: layer
fields.description: Layer orders overlapping profiles exactly as on BiosProfile: (layer, name) merge order, later overrides, same-layer disagreement is a conflict.

fields.name: manager
fields.description: Manager is the desired management-controller firmware. It is flashed over the multipart push the endpoint advertises; endpoints that advertise only SimpleUpdate hold at NoUpdateTransport rather than flashing over an unproven path. Flashing the manager does not stop the machine it manages.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image is a digest-pinned OCI reference to the firmware image (a single- layer artifact in the internal registry, e.g. registry.pk.internal:5000/firmware/x12-bmc@sha256:…). The digest is required: the executor refuses to flash bytes it cannot verify.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version is the desired firmware version, compared verbatim against the version the endpoint serves — the convergence observable.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Match selects Hosts by label (same two axes as BiosProfile.spec.match).

fields.name: matchExpressions
fields.description: Label requirements that the object must meet. All must match.

fields.name: values
fields.description: The values for In and NotIn. Exists and DoesNotExist take no values.

fields.name: matchLabels
fields.description: Labels that the object must have, as key and value pairs. All must match.

fields.name: system
fields.description: System is the desired system firmware: BIOS/UEFI, network cards, RAID controllers, whatever the machine's UpdateService lists in its FirmwareInventory. Each image applies at the next reset of the machine. Thus, on a machine that runs a node, the operation drains the node first and waits for the node after the reset. System firmware converges after the manager's and before BIOS settings (a BIOS update can change the settings it offers).

fields.name: component
fields.description: Component matches FirmwareInventory member ids, as a regular expression over the whole id: BIOS, NIC\.Slot\.[0-9]+, RAID.*. Ids are vendor shaped; kubectl describe managementendpoint lists the ones a machine serves. Every matching entry is brought to the version; a pattern that matches nothing holds the profile at NoMatchingComponent.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image is the digest-pinned OCI reference of the vendor's update package for this component.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version is the desired version, compared verbatim against the version the inventory entry reports.
